svg.title: Rules vs. intelligence
svg.desc: A grey if, elif, else tree that sends a new document format to a manual dead end, beside a violet model core that runs understand, plan, act and check on every document, with a human-review gate for low-confidence cases.

g.text: Every new case is another branch. It breaks on the case
It reasons about each case. Rules become guardrails, not
Deterministic where it must be: validation, permissions, audit. Intelligent everywhere else.
